title: Warm Crisp Ukrainian Natto Skillet
description: A rich and crisp weeknight Ukrainian dish featuring natto, tempered chocolate, and raw friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the olive oil and let it heat up for 1 minute.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the natto and stir to combine with the onions, garlic, and mushrooms, cooking for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tempered chocolate until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to a serving plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
